fields.description: Save header ASCII title, reads 'GT-CHAMP Ver1.00'.

fields.description: Default/unset time sentinel for championship entries (599999).
fields.evidence: FUN_08044dbc inits five stride-0x34 championship entries writing a 32-bit default-time constant per entry; sector header save+0x100C holds 599999 (0x0927BF), repeated in every entry.
fields.name: champ_default_time

fields.description: Championship entry 0 per-round result flags (5 x 0x01).
fields.evidence: FUN_08044f8c writes five 0x01 bytes per stride-0x34 entry (loop <6, offsets +0x28..+0x2C) and FUN_08044dbc loops 5 entries with stride 0x34; entry 0 bytes at save+0x1028 read 01 01 01 01 01.
fields.name: champ_entry0_result_flags

fields.description: Championship entry 0 round-unlock mask (low 5 bits set = 0x001F).
fields.evidence: FUN_08044dbc/FUN_08044f8c/FUN_080454b0 apply 0x1F low-5-bit mask ops (*pb & 0x9f | 0x1f; *pb & 0x80 | idx & 0x1f); word at save+0x1033 reads 0x001F.
fields.name: champ_entry0_unlock_mask

fields.evidence: FUN_08044dbc per-entry default-time init over stride-0x34 entries; u32 at save+0x1040 (entry0 +0x18) reads 599999 (0x0927BF), matching champ_default_time.
fields.name: champ_entry0_best_time

fields.description: Mirror of championship entry 0 best time in sector 2 (identical sectors 1/2/3).
fields.evidence: Sectors at save+0x1000/+0x2000/+0x3000 are byte-identical and each validated by FUN_08044734 slot reads (func_0x0805a188 len 0x1000); u32 at save+0x2040 repeats 599999.
fields.name: champ_entry0_best_time_bak

fields.evidence: FUN_0804509c CpuSets 0x78-byte blocks (stride 0xF0) covering the time-trial table at save+0x4100; u32 at save+0x4130 reads 599999 (0x0927BF).
fields.name: tt_entry0_total_time

fields.description: Time-trial entry 0 per-segment split times (8 x u16_le).
fields.evidence: FUN_0804509c 0x78-byte CpuSet (stride 0xF0) covers the time-trial table; 16 bytes at save+0x4138 hold 8 little-endian segment values (0x27 0x34 0x0d 0x23 0x28 0x21 0x2d 0x30).
fields.name: tt_entry0_split_times

fields.description: Mirror of time-trial entry 0 total time in sector 5 (identical sectors 4/5/6).
fields.evidence: FUN_08044734 slot reads (func_0x0805a188 len 0x1000) validate each sector; sectors at save+0x4000/+0x5000/+0x6000 are byte-identical with matching sum32 checksums; u32 at save+0x5130 repeats 599999.
